fullDescription: A high-performance, dark-themed promotional design featuring CSS 3D transforms, grain textures, and fire-orange accents. Optimized for fitness, SaaS, or tech product launches, this style utilizes depth-based layout containers, interactive 3D tilt components, and bold editorial typography (Clash Grotesk & General Sans). Key visual elements include perspective-shifted mobile mockups, floating status badges, and animated glow pulses.
prompt:
## Resumo
A dynamic 3D-heavy fitness landing page using a dark #0A0A0A base, #F45B20 primary accents, and complex CSS depth effects to create a premium, high-energy brand experience.

## Estilo Visual
Create a high-performance dark mode UI with a perspective-driven layout. 

### Colors
- Background: #0A0A0A (Rich Black)
- Secondary BG: #111111 and #1A1A1A
- Primary Accent: #F45B20 (Fire Orange)
- Accent Hover: #D94A15
- Borders: White at 5% or 10% opacity
- Text: Pure white for headings, White/50% for body text, White/40% for subtle labels.

### Typography
- Headings: Use 'Clash Grotesk' (Weights: 600, 700). Set tracking to tight, line-height to 0.95 for large hero text (64px-72px).
- Body: Use 'General Sans' (Weights: 400, 500, 600). Size: 16px-18px for body, 14px for metadata.

### Visual Effects
- Grain Overlay: Apply a global fixed SVG noise filter with 0.03 opacity.
- 3D Transforms: Use 'perspective: 1200px' on parent containers. Implement 'transform-style: preserve-3d' on children.
- Glows: Use radial gradients (e.g., #F45B20 at 10% opacity) with 80px-100px blurs for background depth.
- Shadows: Use deep 60px blurs with subtle color tinting (rgba(244, 91, 32, 0.15)).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
Create a fixed navigation bar, 64px height, background #0A0A0A with a 1px bottom border (white/5%). Include a brand logo on the left, centered navigation links (14px font size, white/50% color), and a high-contrast orange CTA button on the right (14px font, semi-bold, 10px padding-y, 20px padding-x).

### 3D Hero Section
Design a split-screen hero. Left side: Feature a badge 'Powered by Performance' (fire-500/10% bg), followed by a massive 72px heading with a gradient underline for the middle word. Below, add a paragraph (18px white/50%) and a primary orange button with a hover scale effect. Right side: A 3D phone mockup tilted at 'rotateY(-18deg) rotateX(8deg) rotateZ(2deg)'. Surround the phone with 3 floating status badges (calories, heart rate, streak) using 'transform-style: preserve-3d' and separate floating animations (3.5s to 5s durations).

### Interactive Feature Grid
Build a 3-column grid of cards. Each card (#1A1A1A) should have a 1px border and a 3D tilt effect on mouse hover. Inside, include a 56px icon box with an orange background (10% opacity), a 20px semi-bold heading, and 14px body text (white/40%). Cards must 'lift' on the Z-axis (translateZ(30px)) when hovered.

### App Screenshot Perspective Gallery
Create a horizontal row of 5 mobile screenshots. The central screenshot should be flat and slightly scaled up (1.05x). The screenshots to the left should be rotated at rotateY(8deg) and rotateY(4deg) respectively. Screenshots on the right should be rotateY(-4deg) and rotateY(-8deg). All screenshots must have a 1px border and 2xl shadows.

### Visual Call to Action
A centered layout with a 600px radial glow (#F45B20/10%) in the background. Include a 80px icon container with a rocket or similar icon. Use a large 60px heading and a primary download button flanked by 'App Store' and 'Google Play' buttons in dark style with white borders.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### 3D Tilt Feature Card — A card that responds to mouse movement by tilting in 3D space.
Structure: Container with perspective: 1200px. Card: #1A1A1A, 32px padding, 16px radius. Interaction: Use JavaScript to calculate mouse position relative to card center. Apply 'transform: rotateX(n) rotateY(n)' where n is +/- 8 degrees. Ensure internal elements (icons) have 'translateZ(40px)' to create a parallax pop-out effect on hover.

### Floating Depth Badge — UI elements that appear to float in a different 3D plane than the parent.
Style: #1A1A1A/90% backdrop-blur, 1px border (white/10%), 16px border-radius, shadow-xl. Animation: 'float-badge-anim' moving 12px up and down over 3.5s using ease-in-out. Layering: Must sit at 'translateZ(50px)' relative to the phone mockup container.

style.description: The style is 'Aggressive Minimalist' with 3D depth. It features a heavy reliance on perspective containers (1200px perspective), grain overlays for tactile feel, and a high-contrast palette of pitch black and vibrant orange. Typography is divided into a bold, tight-tracked display face (Clash Grotesk) and a clean geometric body face (General Sans). Animations include floating keyframes and 3D card rotations based on mouse position.
